module: HTTP submodule of the third-party Copas library: full copy of LuaSocket's HTTP/1.1 client (Diego Nehab) modified to handle https, http/https redirects and asynchronous Copas sockets. Defines copas.http; copas.http.request(url[, body]) returns body, code, headers, status. To be called from a Copas coroutine.
notes: With a string URL: GET (or POST if body is given, content-type application/x-www-form-urlencoded); returns body, code, headers, status, or nil + error.
With a table, the advanced request accepts url, method, headers, source, sink, create, etc. (as in LuaSocket).
The first parseRequest defines target (table receiving the body chunks) and sink.

USERAGENT.desc: User-Agent field sent, value of socket._VERSION.

request.desc: request(url_or_table, body): sends an HTTP/HTTPS request (protected by socket.protect).

open.desc: Low-level API: creates the socket (reqt:create()), sets the timeout, connects to reqt.host:reqt.port and returns an HTTP connection object.

parseRequest.desc: Converts the short form into an advanced request table with a target field (results); if a body is given: POST method, content-length and content-type headers.
